STEP 1 - Scene: A pizza meal (cheese and pepperoni-style slices) with a dark chocolate-chip cookie on a white square plate. Photographed from above, roughly top-down, with the plate slightly distorted by perspective.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, about 26 cm across at its longest undistorted width (dinner-plate size). Area of a circle-equivalent ≈ 530 cm²; the square plate's usable area is roughly 500 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Cheese pizza slice (left, one slice)
- Pepperoni/meat pizza slices (right, two slices, with sauce and cheese)
- Chocolate chip cookie (dark, round, small)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate area, ~500 cm² usable):
- Left cheese slice: ~12% = 60 cm² × 0.8 cm = 48 ml × 0.95 = ~46 g
- Right pizza slices (two wedges together): ~30% = 150 cm² × 0.9 cm = 135 ml × 0.95 = ~128 g
- Cookie: ~8% = 40 cm² × 1.0 cm = 40 ml × 0.6 = ~24 g (cookie is dense, ~1 cm thick)

Food covers ~50% of the plate, consistent with the visible items.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pizza totals roughly 183 ml gross; cookie ~40 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Cheese pizza ~46 g, meat pizza ~128 g, cookie ~24 g. Total ≈ 198 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Cheese pizza: 46 g × 266 kcal/100g ≈ 122 kcal
- Meat pizza: 128 g × 280 kcal/100g ≈ 358 kcal
- Cookie: 24 g × 480 kcal/100g ≈ 115 kcal
Total ≈ 595 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Two-and-a-bit slices of pizza plus one cookie is plausible for a light meal; roughly 200 g and ~600 kcal fits what is visible. The left slice is partly a separate piece, so the estimate is reasonable.
